board_date.description: Board manufacturing date/time in 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS' format

board_date_unspec.description: If true, do not use current system date/time for board mfg. date

debug_flags.description: List of debug flags (e.g., ['fver', 'rver']) per --debug option documentation

fields.description: List of field overrides, each with path, value, and optional encoding; 'encoding' defaults to '' (preserve/autodetect)

fields.items.description: Field override entry; each key corresponds to a documented FRU area.field (e.g., 'board.pname') or 'board.custom'/'board.custom.N' for custom fields. Encoding is optional and must be one of: 'auto', '6bitascii', 'bcdplus', 'text', 'binary'.

fields.items.encoding.description: Optional encoding override (e.g., 'text', 'binary'); empty means preserve/autodetect

fields.items.value.description: Value to set for the field

input_file.description: Input file path or '-' for stdin

input_source.description: Input source type: 'raw', 'json', or empty if none
